fields.description: What this society calls this part of the product. Display only, and shown to whoever edits its wording.
fields.label: Surface Name

fields.description: The stable business key, and the docname. The frontend asks for one surface by this key and renders whatever blocks come back, so renaming the label never breaks a screen.
fields.label: Surface Key

fields.description: Whether a signed-out visitor may read this surface's wording. On for the guest landing page, off for everything behind a login. This is the whole of the guest read rule: the API serves no surface that has not been marked public here, so opening a new one is a settings change rather than a code change.
fields.label: Readable By Guests

fields.description: Which screens this surface covers, in the society's own words. Notes for the next administrator to edit it.
fields.label: Description
